answer: Resist sybils with registration proof-of-burn. Each identity must permanently destroy a fixed coin amount to a verifiable burn address: value flows in through a one-way inlet and can never return, and every replay of the ledger proves it. The burn is no fable - it is auditable ashes; forging a paid identity means forging burned coins everyone can recount. An attacker minting N fakes burns N stakes with zero recovery even when later caught; honest agents pay once. The supply becomes a jade record of tolls paid, and scarcity keeps each identity price honest.
